ImportOutputMaxQuant() function import data, pay attention important arguments: MaxQuant_table_name: “proteinGroups.txt” file (path file) exported MaxQuant within txt folder. samples_info: optional, metadata table samples, samples belong certain sample groups, can upload passing file name (path file). fasta_database: leave missing; want fill missing Protein names Gene names MaxQuant, can specify either “human” “mouse” (case package use pre-loaded fasta tables) fasta table can write file name (path file) considered. fasta input used function simplified version reference proteome FASTA file downloaded UniProt website 05/03/2024 (, generally, FASTA file used MaxQuant search). original FASTA file adapted tabular format containing three fields required annotation: Accession, Protein name, Gene name. raw_or_LFQ: output MaxQuant usually raw intenstities intensities normalised “LFQ” (Label-Free Quantification) algorithm. Choose ones want imported elaborations. prioritize_MaxQuant_names; case different Protein name Gene names fasta database imported MaxQuant, can specify TRUE want prioritise names MaxQuant. remove_identified_by_site, remove_reverse, remove_potential_contaminant: pass TRUE argument want remove rows characteristics (overview operation printed console) Great, creates -called “GCP list”! Throughout workflow, keep working list, always made 3 data frames: intensities: row protein, uniquely identified column ‘protid’, column sample. proteinINFO: besides ‘protid’ column, , every column contains information related protein group. sampleINFO: information samples, example group sample belongs .

text: , ensure better normal distribution data, log-transformation strongly advised. Use function GCP_LogTransformIntensities: good idea might also remove proteins missing values many samples. can use GCP_FilterNAperCondition ratio 0.5 means protein removed 50% missing values condition (conditions defined, always, option ‘name_column_groups’ set; can specified explicitly ‘name_column_groups’ argument). also another function useful run just missing value imputation, useful check proteins common among groups: now ’s time impute missing values! ’ll scImpute() tImpute() functions “PhosR” package, ’ll simple easy step using function GCP_NAimputation: point, standardise data, ’re using LFQ intensities. ’d describe function GCP_ScaleIntensities: first argument, usual, GCPlist; ‘subtract’ argument specify subtract, .e. center data. Choose “mean” subtract mean “median” subtract median. actually additional option, “shift_median”, ’ll describe later…. (bit suspense !); argument ‘divide’ can specify scale data among: “sd” divide standard deviation, “sqrt_sd” divide square root standard deviation, “maxmin” divide range (difference maximum minimum); by_sample TRUE perform centering scaling per sample, FALSE perform protein. , , by_sample TRUE, don’t want negative values centering operation, option “shift_median” argument subtract center value global median (just subtracting offset). IMPORTANT: specify anything last argument ‘name_column_groups’, take set option usual, shift median performed differently group: .e.: sample group centered global median group. instead want perform group-wise shift, just shift global median samples, remember add set argument ‘name_column_groups’ NULL.
